files.text:
story:
    id: halve-negative
    feature: calculator
    title: Halve negative integers
    as_a: Calculator User
    i_want: to halve an already validated negative integer, rounding toward zero
    so_that: I can calculate half its value
    status: PLANNED
    acceptance_criteria:
        - id: 001-even
          description: The calculator must return -3 when the Calculator User halves -6.
          steps:
            - given:
                - the number is "-6"
            - when:
                - the Calculator User halves the number
            - then:
                - the result is "-3"
        - id: 002-odd
          description: The calculator must return -3 when the Calculator User halves -7.
          steps:
            - given:
                - the number is "-7"
            - when:
                - the Calculator User halves the number
            - then:
                - the result is "-3"
        - id: 003-rounds-to-zero
          description: The calculator must return 0 when the Calculator User halves -1.
          steps:
            - given:
                - the number is "-1"
            - when:
                - the Calculator User halves the number
            - then:
                - the result is "0"
